description.value:
Duration constant

A graft in an Afflicted's flesh answers to the Afflicted, not to you. Resonance from bio-augments installed in your Afflicted no longer contributes to your own Resonance total in any way, and it is tracked entirely on the Afflicted itself. This does not change how much Resonance the augment adds to the Afflicted, and it does not protect the Afflicted from its own Resonance bands.

cinderfall.incomplete: Afflicted is this class's minion subsystem: a raise-cap, a collapse timer, and (at level 18) a shared cross-actor Resonance pool. pf2e's schema has no generic "max controlled minions" field, no "minion lifespan" field, and no mechanism for one actor's rule element to modify a different actor's stats on an ongoing basis. Per-minion Resonance tracking, no cross-actor mechanism.
